eligibility.Eligibility Rationale: The study applies a deep learning algorithm to improve histologic diagnosis of antibody‑mediated rejection, but it does not assess transplant survival, waitlist mortality, post‑transplant complications, quality of life, or economic outcomes, which are required outcome criteria.

identification_methods.Comments: Retrospective study using annotated endomyocardial biopsy slides from Duke University Medical Center to develop and validate a deep learning algorithm for pAMR-H detection.
identification_methods.Institution: Duke University Medical Center, Division of Artificial Intelligence and Computational Pathology
identification_methods.Address: 217AM Davison Building, Box 3712, 40 Duke Medicine Circle, Durham NC 27710
identification_methods.Dataset Source: 300 H&E stained endomyocardial biopsy slides scanned with Leica Aperio GT450 at Duke
identification_methods.Identification Notes: Biopsies confirmed as pAMR2 with >50% C4d IF positivity and/or >10% CD68 positive intravascular macrophages; 4,212 annotated regions (normal, pAMR-H, healing injury, ACR).
identification_methods.AI Model Architecture: ResNet50 convolutional neural network with transfer learning
identification_methods.Input Variables: Whole slide image patches (224x224 pixels) from H&E stained slides
identification_methods.Validation Method: 70% training, 10% validation, 20% testing split; internal hold‑out validation
identification_methods.Methods Notes: Expert consensus panel of 16 cardiac pathologists defined ground truth; annotations performed in Leica ImageScope; model trained with cross‑entropy loss and Adam optimizer; performance evaluated via accuracy and AUC.

population.Inclusion criteria: Endomyocardial biopsy fragments from cardiac transplant patients confirmed with pAMR2 between 2018 and 2021 at Duke University Medical Center
population.Population Notes: Samples collected from a single center (Duke) with IRB approval; biopsies stored in formalin and paraffin embedded
population.Diagnosis: pAMR2 (pathologic antibody mediated rejection) confirmed by >50% C4d IF or >10% CD68+ intravascular macrophages

interventions_outcomes.Specific Algorithm Name: ResNet50 convolutional neural network with transfer learning
interventions_outcomes.Intervention Input Data Modality: Whole slide H&E images scanned at 40X magnification
interventions_outcomes.Interventions Notes: Model pretrained on ImageNet, fine‑tuned on annotated patches using cross entropy loss and Adam optimizer
interventions_outcomes.Reported outcomes in study: Overall validation accuracy, category‑specific accuracies, area under ROC curve (AUC)
interventions_outcomes.Outcomes Notes: Overall accuracy 98%; pAMR‑H vs normal 99.5%, vs healing injury 99.2%, vs ACR 99.2%; AUC reported as 0.992 for comparisons
interventions_outcomes.Result data Notes: Algorithm achieved high diagnostic performance, potentially surpassing human pathologist concordance
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Reporting: 98% overall validation accuracy; 99.5% vs normal, 99.2% vs healing injury, 99.2% vs ACR
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Metric Definition: Proportion of correctly classified patches; AUC from ROC analysis on test set
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Notes: High accuracy suggests AI can aid pathologist diagnosis of pAMR‑H
